newsitem.title: UK: U.S.' Daley says current growth rate may moderate.
newsitem.headline: U.S.' Daley says current growth rate may moderate.

text.p: U.S. Commerce Secretary William Daley said on Wednesday it was difficult to imagine that the current pace of U.S. economic growth could be sustained. But he said that he and many other experts had been forecasting a moderation of growth for a while and it had not materialised yet. "It's hard to imagine that we can maintain the pace we've grown at, but at this stage, nothing surprises me," he told Reuters Financial Television.

"I guess I'd better get out of the prediction game." Daley told RFTV that strong public spending restraint and a deficit reduction plan, which is on course for a balanced budget in five years, was all very positive for the economy.
He said he still hoped to see a reduction in the overall U.S. Trade deficit but said it remains to be see whether that would happen.
